# Spydra

Spydra OpenRWA provides public-chain token store APIs for assets, tokens, sales, investments, investor workflows, payouts, and chain configuration.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/spydra/.

## Actions

- **Get Asset** (read-only): Return detailed information for one OpenRWA asset, optionally including token or token-sale projections.
- **Get Asset Status Counts** (read-only): Return asset counts grouped by publication status for the connected OpenRWA token store.
- **List Asset Tokens** (read-only): Return the tokens associated with one OpenRWA asset.
- **List Assets** (read-only): Return one numbered page of draft or published assets in the connected OpenRWA token store.
- **List Chains** (read-only): Return supported OpenRWA blockchain networks and their public network, currency, status, and fee attributes.
- **List Countries** (read-only): Return the complete OpenRWA country reference list, including ISO codes, currencies, languages, and dialing codes.
- **List Investor Tokens** (read-only): Return one numbered page of tokens held or invested in by a specific OpenRWA investor.
- **List Investor Transactions** (read-only): Return one numbered page of mint, payout, burn, or token-creation transactions for a specific OpenRWA investor.
- **List Investors** (read-only): Return one numbered page of investors registered with the connected OpenRWA token store.
- **List Token Sales** (read-only): Search and filter one numbered page of OpenRWA token sales available through the connected store.
